name: CMS Property Management
why_selected: Residential single-family/small-multifamily manager (office at 33 Brunswick Woods Dr, East Brunswick) advertising coverage of 8 NJ counties and 25 Middlesex towns; 4.5 stars across 116 Google reviews and AppFolio-based owner/tenant portals indicate a high-volume, software-dependent operation.

name: Towne & Country Management
why_selected: HOA/condo/high-rise manager (HQ 100 Menlo Park Dr, Edison, plus Red Bank office) with about 47 communities and 11,000+ homes under management; LinkedIn shows ~54 employees and +8% YoY headcount growth, a multi-office expansion signal.

name: RCP Management Company
why_selected: Community association manager (condo, townhome, HOA, hi-rise) founded 1974 and headquartered in Cranbury, holding both AAMC and AMO designations; publishes town-by-town service pages across Middlesex County, suggesting a large, geographically dispersed portfolio.

name: Ross Management Group
why_selected: Commercial office/warehouse property manager, developer and landlord at 409 Joyce Kilmer Ave, New Brunswick; rehab-and-lease model with an in-house leasing pipeline (suite and warehouse listings) rather than a pure fee manager.

name: Barrood Real Estate
why_selected: Independent, family-owned brokerage at 700 Easton Ave, Franklin Township, operating since 1940 with three generations and 14 agents/staff; site states 244 homes sold/listed by the managing broker on Zillow - steady listing volume plus residential, rental and commercial lines.

name: David M Sweeney Realty, LLC
why_selected: Boutique independent brokerage at 991 US 22, Bridgewater, covering residential, luxury and investment property in Somerset County; self-described deliberately small team citing 10,000+ transactions across 13 states - a growing regional books-and-client base run by a lean staff.
